title: Set the system timezone
summary: Change the system's timezone to a specific region. You need to know the exact timezone name (e.g., 'Europe/Moscow' or 'America/New_York').

steps.explain: Set the system timezone to the specified value. Replace <TIMEZONE> with a valid timezone name from the list.

placeholders.name: TIMEZONE
placeholders.description: The name of the timezone to set (e.g., Europe/London, America/New_York).

rollback.explain: To revert, set the timezone back to its previous value using the same command.

placeholders.name: PREVIOUS_TIMEZONE
placeholders.description: The timezone name that was set before the change.

warnings: Changing the timezone affects how dates and times are displayed and logged across the system.
